top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a mature, independently confirmed discovery chain: GLP-1 as a glucose-dependent incretin, identification and synthesis of its active GLP-1(7-36) form, and receptor biology, validated by large randomized trials in glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The citation is scoped to incretin physiology and the active form, with no claim of first discovery of the incretin concept and no credit for drug development. The Mojsov versus Habener priority question remains unresolved from the supplied evidence, but it does not outweigh the strength of the achievement, so no award (P000) ranks below it.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented tie to the GLP-1 candidates (profile ties to Perlmann, Ernfors and Grillner concern unrelated work)
